grh_3a8c718a791cfacb524d.title: Katie Mac Beth
paragraphs: Drifter Toby Hibbert takes work at the McBeth ranch and begins an affair with Katie McBeth while her husband Alex is away. Katie's elderly father-in-law Ramsey discovers the relationship and attacks Toby, but after Toby escapes wounded, Ramsey dies under circumstances Katie later admits were her doing. When Alex returns and confronts the lovers, Toby restrains him while Katie kills him, and they hide his body deep in the wine cellar. Their secret unravels as Toby's guilt grows and another woman exposes what she knows; Toby finally confesses and leads the sheriff to Alex's body. Katie is convicted and sentenced to hang, but after giving premature birth in the prison hospital she dies from internal bleeding before the execution can take place.

grh_3a036e285d3ff131a545.title: Assignment Usa
paragraphs: A documentary-style adaptation of Selden Menefee's Assignment USA surveys wartime America after a 15,000-mile reporting trip. The program praises enormous industrial and military effort while also confronting racial discrimination, southern economic grievances, labor-management conflict, housing shortages and other weaknesses that divide the home front. Menefee appears at the end to affirm that Americans are broadly committed to democratic war aims and argues that informed citizens must correct those failures if the country is to win both the war and the peace.
